_note: Written by hand as a model would answer the tavily_search_splitwise.json results (no LLM key existed in phase 4). It repeats Tricount under two names and invents one URL on purpose, to exercise merging and URL checking.

kept.name: Splitwise
kept.positioning: The best-known app for splitting bills and tracking shared expenses.
kept.target_users: Flatmates, couples and friends on trips

kept.name: Tricount
kept.positioning: A free, ad-free way to share group expenses.
kept.target_users: Friends on trips, flatshares and couples
kept.reason: It splits group expenses for the same users and has no daily limit.

kept.name: tricount: Split & Settle Bills
kept.positioning: Organises group expenses and tells who owes whom.
kept.reason: Same product as listed on Google Play.

kept.name: Settle Up
kept.positioning: Tracks a group's expenses and shows who should pay next, also offline.
kept.reason: It solves the same shared-expense problem.

kept.name: Splitkaro
kept.positioning: An Indian bill splitting app with UPI settle-up.
kept.reason: It targets the same users in India and settles over UPI.

kept.name: Splid
kept.positioning: Bill splitting that needs no sign-up.
kept.reason: It is listed as a direct alternative.

rejected.name: YNAB
rejected.reason: Personal budgeting for one person, not splitting shared expenses.

rejected.name: How to split rent fairly with roommates
